newsitem.title: USA: Tobacco cos have no comment on settlement report.
newsitem.headline: Tobacco cos have no comment on settlement report.

text.p: The four tobacco companies involved in a variety of litigation had no comment on a report of global settlement talks, an industry spokesman said.
The spokesman declined any other comment.

The Wall Street Journal reported on Wednesday that the two largest cigarette companies in the U.S., Philip Morris Cos Inc and RJR Nabisco Holdings Corp, were in secret talks with tobacco plaintiffs about a sweeping settlement.

A source close to the talks on Wednesday told Reuters that tobacco executives are negotiating with state attorneys general and plaintiffs' lawyers on a settlement, and lawyers hope to conclude the first round of talks later in the day.
The spokesman said the two other companies involved in litigation include Loews Corp's Lorillard unit, and B.A.T Industries Plc.
